spanish: Lepra envejecida ella en piel de su carne, y lo impurecerá el sacerdote; no lo encerrará, porque impuro él.

findings.issue: Piel sequential perfect of H2930 leaves factitive and declarative force open; «impurecerá» selects causing impurity.

notes: Pronouns, construct, article, and the bare negative match the tokens.
